chap_01_p01.name: 可数名词及其单复数变化规则与不规则变化
chap_01_p01.page_ref: 手绘语法教材 P1-P3 · 对应外研七上 Starter & Unit 1

citations.source: 外研版七上 Starter 课本真实对白
citations.text: Mum: Where is your schoolbag? Li Ming: There are two books, three pencils and an eraser in it.
citations.note: books 与 pencils 为规则复数加 -s；eraser 属元音音素开头单词用 an。

citations.source: 初中英语语法图解 (P2) 手写精要
citations.text: 以 s, x, ch, sh 结尾加 -es (buses, boxes, watches, dishes)；以“辅音+y”结尾变 y 为 i 加 -es (family -> families, story -> stories)。
citations.note: 元音字母+y结尾直接加 -s (holiday -> holidays, boy -> boys)。

rules: 规则变化四步法：一般加 -s；特殊辅音结尾加 -es；辅音+y 变 ies；f/fe 结尾常变 ves (half -> halves, knife -> knives, leaf -> leaves)。
不规则变化核心群：变元音 (man->men, foot->feet, tooth->teeth)；加 -en (child->children)；单复同形 (sheep, deer, Chinese, fish)。
复合名词复数规则：一般仅后词加 -s (apple trees)；由 man/woman 构成的复合词，前后均变复数 (men teachers, women doctors)。
chap_01_p01.pitfalls: 【高频陷阱】：photo->photos, piano->pianos（外来词均加 -s）；German 变复数为 Germans（非 Germen）；stomach 结尾发 /k/ 音，复数直接加 -s (stomachs)。

exercises.question: There are forty ______ in our school, and three of them are from Germany. They are all friendly ______.
options: A. woman teachers; Germans
B. women teachers; Germans
C. women teachers; Germen
D. woman teachers; Germen
exercises.explanation: woman 构成的职业复合名词，前后两词均需变复数：women teachers；German（德国人）变复数直接加 -s (Germans)，不可与 English/French 混淆。故选 B。

exercises.question: The farmer raised fifty ______ and twenty ______ on his green hill.
options: A. sheeps; cows
B. sheep; cows
C. sheep; cow
D. deers; cows
exercises.explanation: sheep（绵羊）与 deer（鹿）均为单复同形名词，复数形式不加 -s；cow（母牛）为规则可数名词，复数加 -s。故选 B。

chap_01_p02.name: 不可数名词的计量与常见易错不可数名词
chap_01_p02.page_ref: 手绘语法教材 P4-P5 · 对应外研七上 Unit 2

citations.source: 外研七上精读课文原句
citations.text: Emma asked the librarian for some advice on starting a writing club in the reading room.
citations.note: advice（建议）为典型不可数名词，不能说 an advice 或 advices，可用 some advice 或 a piece of advice。

citations.source: 初中英语语法图解 (P4) 分类树
citations.text: 不可数名词无复数形式，前面不能直接加 a/an 或数词。表示数量需借助“数词 + 计量词 + of + 不可数名词”。
citations.note: 如：a cup of tea, two slices of bread, three pieces of news。

rules: 六大中考必考抽象不可数名词：information (信息), advice (建议), news (新闻), progress (进步), fun (乐趣), homework (家庭作业)。
物质类不可数名词：water, bread, milk, beef, pork, rice, paper, money。
主谓一致原则：不可数名词作主语时，谓语动词一律用单数；若带复数计量词 (e.g. two glasses of water)，谓语动词随计量词用复数。
chap_01_p02.pitfalls: 【高频陷阱】：news 词尾有 -s 但为不可数名词，谓语动词用 is；practice 与 exercise 作锻炼时不可数，作具体练习题时可数。

exercises.question:
—Could you give me ______ on how to improve my spoken English?
—Sure, listening to English songs is a good choice.
options: A. an advice
B. some advices
C. a piece of advice
D. many advices
exercises.explanation: advice 为不可数名词，没有复数形式，不能加不定冠词 an。表达一条建议用 a piece of advice。故选 C。

exercises.question: No news ______ good news. Don't worry too much about your test result.
options: A. is
B. are
C. were
D. been
exercises.explanation: news 虽然以 -s 结尾，但在英语中是不可数名词，作主语时谓语动词用单数 is。故选 A。

chap_01_p03.name: 名词所有格 ('s 与 of 格及双重所有格)
chap_01_p03.page_ref: 手绘语法教材 P6-P9 · 对应外研七上 Family ties

citations.source: 外研七上 Family ties 课文原句
citations.text: A picture of a loving family moment brings back sweet memories of my childhood.
citations.note: a picture of... 为无生命及描绘性名词常用的 of 所有格结构。

citations.source: 初中语法手绘精要 (P7)
citations.text: 单数名词直接加 's (Tom's cat)；以 s 结尾的规则复数只加撇 ' (teachers' day)；不规则复数仍加 's (children's books)。
citations.note: 共同所有与各自所有：A and B's room (共有1间) vs A's and B's rooms (各自有间)。

rules: 's 所有格：有生命的人或动物通常用 's；时间、距离、国家机构亦可用 (today's news, ten minutes' walk)。
of 所有格：无生命事物多用 of (the door of the classroom, the capital of China)。
双重所有格：“of + 名词性物主代词 / 名词's”，强调部分概念 (a friend of mine, two books of Tom's)。
chap_01_p03.pitfalls: 【易混考点】：Lucy and Lily's bedroom（两人共住一间，bedroom 用单数）；Lucy's and Lily's bedrooms（各自有一间，bedrooms 用复数）。

exercises.question: This is ______ bedroom. They have lived in the same room since they were born.
options: A. Lucy's and Lily's
B. Lucy and Lily's
C. Lucy's and Lily
D. Lucy and Lily
exercises.explanation: 后句说明两人同住一个房间，表示两人共同拥有，只需在最后一个名字后加 's。故选 B。

exercises.question: Tomorrow is ______ Day. Let's make some greeting cards for them.
options: A. Teacher's
B. Teachers'
C. Teachers
D. Teacher
exercises.explanation: 教师节是所有老师共同的节日，teachers 为规则复数，结尾有 s，所有格直接加撇 '。故选 B。

chap_02_p01.name: 不定冠词 a / an 的读音判别与泛指用法
chap_02_p01.page_ref: 手绘语法教材 P10-P11 · 对应外研七上 Starter

citations.source: 外研七上日常对白原句
citations.text: Tina's mother is an actress at an amusement park. She often dresses up as a fairy queen.
citations.note: actress 和 amusement 均为元音音素开头，前面用 an；fairy 辅音音素开头，用 a。

citations.source: 初中英语语法图解 (P10) 警示栏
citations.text: 决定用 a 还是 an 的是单词开头的“音素（发音）”，而非“字母拼写”！
citations.note: 元音音素开头的字母：a, e, i, o, f, h, l, m, n, r, s, x。

rules: 用 a 的场景：单词开头以“辅音音素”发音 (a book, a European country, a university, a useful book)。
用 an 的场景：单词开头以“元音音素”发音 (an apple, an hour, an honest boy, an 8-year-old girl, an MP3 player)。
单字母选用：字母 A, E, I, O, F, H, L, M, N, R, S, X 在单字母发音时以元音开头，前面均加 an (There is an 'h' in hour)。
chap_02_p01.pitfalls: 【经典陷阱】：university, useful, European 虽然以元音字母 u/e 开头，但其国际音标为 /juː/（以辅音音素 /j/ 开头），前面用 a！hour, honest 首字母 h 不发音，音标以元音 /aʊ/、/ɒ/ 开头，前面用 an！

exercises.question: It took me ______ hour to finish the task, but it gave me ______ useful lesson.
options: A. a; an
B. an; a
C. an; an
D. a; a
exercises.explanation: hour 中的 h 不发音，以元音音素 /aʊ/ 开头，用 an；useful 以辅音音素 /j/ 开头，用 a。故选 B。

exercises.question: There is ______ 's' and ______ 'u' in the word 'sun'.
options: A. a; a
B. an; a
C. a; an
D. an; an
exercises.explanation: 字母 s 的发音为 /es/，以元音音素 /e/ 开头，用 an；字母 u 的发音为 /juː/，以辅音音素 /j/ 开头，用 a。故选 B。

chap_02_p02.name: 定冠词 the 的特指与零冠词固定搭配
chap_02_p02.page_ref: 手绘语法教材 P11-P13 · 对应外研七上 Unit 2

citations.source: 外研七上 Unit 2 课文原句
citations.text: Rock music meets the erhu! The students enjoy playing the violin and playing basketball after school.
citations.note: 乐器前加 the (the erhu, the violin)；西洋棋/球类运动前不用冠词 (play basketball)。

citations.source: 初中英语语法速记口诀 (P12)
citations.text: 特指双熟悉，上文已提及；独一无二物，序数最高级；普专乐器姓，零冠球三餐。
citations.note: 三餐球类学科前通常零冠词，但加定语特指时加 the (the breakfast he cooked)。

rules: the 的必考场景：特指双方已知事物；第二次提及的名词；世界上独一无二的事物 (the sun, the moon, the earth)；序数词与形容词最高级前；西洋/民族乐器前；姓氏复数表一家人 (the Browns)。
零冠词必考场景：三餐饭 (have breakfast)；球类与棋类 (play football, play chess)；学科与语言 (learn English)；季节月份星期 (in spring, on Monday)。
有无 the 意义不同：in hospital (住院) vs in the hospital (在医院里探病)；at table (进餐) vs at the table (在桌旁)。
chap_02_p02.pitfalls: 【易混点】：play the piano (西洋乐器加 the) vs play football (球类不加 the)；by train (乘坐火车不用 the) vs on the train (在火车上用 the)。

exercises.question: My brother loves music. He can play ______ piano very well, but he doesn't like playing ______ football.
options: A. the; the
B. /; the
C. the; /
exercises.explanation: 乐器名称前须加定冠词 the (play the piano)；球类运动名称前不用冠词 (play football)。故选 C。

exercises.question: Xi'an is ______ ancient city with ______ long history.
options: A. an; a
B. a; a
C. the; a
D. an; the
exercises.explanation: ancient 以元音音素开头泛指一座古城，用 an；a long history（悠久的历史）为固定泛指短语。故选 A。

chap_03_p01.name: 人称代词（主格/宾格）与物主代词（形容词性/名词性）
chap_03_p01.page_ref: 手绘语法教材 P14-P15 · 对应外研七上 Starter

citations.source: 外研七上 Starter 对白原句
citations.text: This is my new classmate. I often help him with his English, and he helps me too.
citations.note: I/he 作主语用主格；help 动词后用宾格 him/me；his 为形容词性物主代词修饰名词。

citations.source: 初中语法手绘精要 (P14)
citations.text: 动介之后用宾格，名物代等于形物代加名词！
citations.note: 公式：名物代 (mine, yours, hers) = 形物代 (my, your, her) + 名词。

rules: 人称代词位置：主格在句首作主语 (I, you, he, she, it, we, they)；宾格在及物动词或介词后作宾语 (me, you, him, her, it, us, them)。
形容词性物主代词：相当于形容词，后面必须紧跟名词 (my pen, our school)。
名词性物主代词：相当于独立名词，后绝不能带名词 (This ruler is mine = my ruler)。
chap_03_p01.pitfalls: 【易混点】：between you and me (介词 between 后必须用宾格 me，不能用 I)；it's (it is 缩写) 与 its (它的，物主代词) 的拼写混淆。

exercises.question:
—Is this Alice's schoolbag?
—No, ______ is pink. This black one must be ______.
options: A. her; your
B. hers; yours
C. hers; your
D. her; yours
exercises.explanation: 第一空指代“她的书包”，且后无名词，用名词性物主代词 hers；第二空同样单独作表语指“你的书包”，用名词性物主代词 yours。故选 B。

exercises.question: Just between you and ______, he didn't tell ______ the truth.
options: A. I; we
B. me; us
C. me; our
D. I; us
exercises.explanation: between 为介词，介词后的人称代词必须用宾格 me；动词 tell 后也接宾语，用宾格 us。故选 B。

chap_03_p02.name: 反身代词 (-self / -selves) 的用法与固定搭配
chap_03_p02.page_ref: 手绘语法教材 P16-P17 · 对应外研七上 Starter 单词表

citations.source: 外研七上单词表原词引用
citations.text: pron. (pl. yourselves) 你自己 / 你们自己 · Help yourselves to some fruit, children!
citations.note: 复数反身代词为 yourselves，单数形式为 yourself。

citations.source: 初中英语语法图解 (P16)
citations.text: 主语动作作用于主语本身时用反身代词。单数加 -self，复数变 f 为 v 加 -selves。
citations.note: myself, yourself, himself, herself, itself; ourselves, yourselves, themselves。

rules: 构成规则：第一、二人称在形容词性物主代词后加 self/selves (myself, ourselves)；第三人称在宾格后加 self/selves (himself, themselves)。
常见中考固定搭配：help oneself to (随便吃/用), enjoy oneself (玩得开心), teach oneself / learn by oneself (自学), hurt oneself (伤到自己), look after oneself (照顾自己), by oneself (独自)。
chap_03_p02.pitfalls: 【注意】：himself 和 themselves 不可错拼为 hisself 或 theirselves；单数 yourself 与复数 yourselves 需根据称呼对象单复数精准匹配。

exercises.question: Boys and girls, help ______ to some fresh strawberries on the table.
options: A. yourself
B. yourselves
C. yourselves'
D. them
exercises.explanation: 称呼语为 Boys and girls（复数概念），故反身代词应选用复数形式 yourselves。故选 B。

exercises.question: The boy is only six years old, but he can dress ______ every morning.
options: A. him
B. himself
C. his
D. he
exercises.explanation: 主语是 The boy，动作施加于主语自己，dress oneself 为固定短语表示自己穿衣。故选 B。

chap_05_p01.name: 时间介词 in / on / at 的精准层级划分与固定口诀
chap_05_p01.page_ref: 手绘语法教材 P32-P33 · 对应外研七上 Starter

citations.source: 外研七上课文与作息表原句
citations.text: Our class starts at 8:00 in the morning on weekdays, and on Friday afternoon we have PE.
citations.note: 具体钟点用 at；泛指早中晚用 in；具体某一天及某天的特定上下午用 on。

citations.source: 初中英语速记手绘金牌口诀 (P32)
citations.text: in 年 in 月 in 季节，大段时间 in 里歇；on 节 on 日 on 某天，具体某天早中晚；at 点钟 at 黎明，小刻瞬间 at 显灵。
citations.note: 遇到 this, that, last, next, every 等词修饰时间时，前面一律不加介词。

rules: at (精确时间点/短暂瞬间)：at 7:30, at noon, at night, at midnight, at the moment, at the weekend。
on (具体某一天或特定某天的上下午)：on Monday, on October 1st, on a rainy morning, on the evening of May 2nd, on Teachers' Day。
in (长于一天的大时间段)：in 2026, in summer, in October, in the morning/afternoon/evening, in a week (一周之后)。
chap_05_p01.pitfalls: 【易混陷阱】：in the morning (泛指早晨) vs on a sunny morning (有形容词修饰的具体早晨用 on)；on Children's Day (具体节日当天用 on) vs at Christmas (节日期间用 at)。

exercises.question: Shenzhou-18 landed safely on Earth ______ the morning of November 4th, 2024.
options: A. in
B. on
C. at
D. by
exercises.explanation: 虽然有 the morning，但后面有 of November 4th 限定，属于具体某一天的早晨，必须用介词 on。故选 B。

exercises.question: We usually have lunch ______ noon, and go to the science lab ______ 2:00 p.m.
options: A. at; at
B. in; on
C. at; in
D. in; at
exercises.explanation: at noon（在中午）为固定搭配；2:00 p.m. 为具体钟点，前面用介词 at。故选 A。

chap_08_p01.name: 一般现在时与第三人称单数 (do/does)
chap_08_p01.chapter: 第8章 动词时态与语态
chap_08_p01.page_ref: 手绘语法教材 P82-P84 · 对应外研七上 Unit 1 & 启帆课笔记

citations.source: 启帆课学习笔记原题
citations.text: Tina's mother works at an amusement park. She doesn't like her mother's dress when she picks her up.
citations.note: 主语为第三人称单数 (Tina's mother/she)，肯定句谓语加 -s (works/picks)；否定句借助动词 doesn't，后接动词原形 like。

citations.source: 初中英语语法手绘图解 (P83)
citations.text: 客观真理、格言警句、经常性习惯动作，一律使用一般现在时，无论主句在何时！
citations.note: 谚语引用：A happy family brings success in everything. (家和万事兴)

rules: 使用语境：表示现在的状态、经常性习惯性动作、客观真理与科学事实。
三单动词变化：一般加 -s；以 s, x, ch, sh, o 结尾加 -es (passes, fixes, watches, washes, goes)；以辅音+y 结尾变 y 为 i 加 -es (studies, flies)；特殊变化 have -> has。
常搭配的时间标志词：always, usually, often, sometimes, seldom, never, every day/week, once a week。
chap_08_p01.pitfalls: 【致命陷阱】：客观真理即使在过去的宾语从句中也绝不倒退时态 (Our teacher said that the earth goes around the sun)；助动词 does/doesn't 出现后，实义动词必须打回原形！

exercises.question: The ancient Greek philosopher proved that the earth ______ around the sun.
options: A. went
B. goes
C. is going
D. will go
exercises.explanation: “地球绕着太阳转”属于永恒的客观科学真理，在宾语从句中不受主句过去时态影响，必须使用一般现在时。故选 B。

exercises.question: My cousin ______ like drinking coffee, but she ______ milk every day.
options: A. doesn't; drinks
B. don't; drinks
C. doesn't; drink
D. isn't; drinks
exercises.explanation: 主语 My cousin 是第三人称单数，实义动词 like 的否定需借助助动词 doesn't；后半句肯定句谓语动词需加 -s 变为 drinks。故选 A。

chap_08_p04.name: 现在完成时 (have/has + done) 与延续性动词转换
chap_08_p04.chapter: 第8章 动词时态与语态
chap_08_p04.page_ref: 手绘语法教材 P88-P91 · 中考高频核心考点

citations.source: 中考完形填空经典原题引用
citations.text: Mr. Green has lived in China for over ten years, so he has been to many famous cities.
citations.note: for + 一段时间与延续性动词 has lived 连用；has been to 表示去过某地已返回。

citations.source: 初中英语语法图解 (P89) 瞬间动词转换清单
citations.text: 瞬间动词（终止性动词）不可与表示一段的时间状语 (for..., since...) 连用！必须转化为对应延续性状态。
citations.note: buy -> have; borrow -> keep; die -> be dead; join -> be in / be a member of; leave -> be away。

rules: 基本结构：have / has + 过去分词 (done)。
三大标志词群：1. already (肯定句), yet (否定/疑问句); 2. ever, never, just, recently; 3. for + 时间段, since + 时间点/过去时从句。
辨析三大句型：have been to (去过某地已回), have gone to (去了某地未回), have been in (已在某地呆了多久)。
chap_08_p04.pitfalls: 【最高频错题】：不能说 *I have bought this book for three years*，买是一个瞬间动作，不能延续三年！必须改为 I have had this book for three years。

exercises.question: His grandfather ______ for nearly five years, but he still misses him very much.
options: A. died
B. has died
C. has been dead
D. was dead
exercises.explanation: 句中有 for nearly five years（长达五年的一段时间），谓语动词必须使用延续性状态。die 是瞬间动词不可连用，需转为 be dead 状态。故选 C。

exercises.question:
—Where is your headteacher?
—He ______ Beijing for an education meeting. He will be back next Monday.
options: A. has been to
B. has gone to
C. went to
D. has been in
exercises.explanation: 由后句“下周一才回来”可知班主任现在还在北京或在去往北京的路上（去了未归），必须用 have/has gone to。故选 B。

chap_10_p01.name: 宾语从句三要素 (连接词/陈述语序/主从时态呼应)
chap_10_p01.page_ref: 手绘语法教材 P112-P115 · 中考单选与完形必考

citations.source: 外研七上与中考真题典型句子
citations.text: Could you please tell me where the library is? Emma wants to know if they can start a reading club.
citations.note: 宾语从句无论主句是否为疑问句，从句内部必须使用“陈述语序（主语在前，动词在后）”！

citations.source: 初中英语语法速记口诀 (P113)
citations.text: 宾从三要素：引导词、陈述序、时态呼。主现从不限，主过从必过，客观真理永现！
citations.note: if / whether 引导一般疑问句变来的从句，意为“是否”；特殊疑问词引导原疑问句。

rules: 要素一·连接词：陈述句充当宾从用 that (可省)；一般疑问句用 if / whether (是否)；特殊疑问句用原有疑问词 (who, where, when, why, how)。
要素二·语序铁律：从句必须是“连接词 + 主语 + 谓语 + 其他”的陈述语序，绝不能用 does/did/is 倒装！
要素三·时态呼应：主句一般现在时，从句按实际需要选时态；主句一般过去时，从句必须退回过去某一时态；客观真理不受限永远用一般现在时。
chap_10_p01.pitfalls: 【经典陷阱】：Could you tell me... 虽以 Could 开头，但属于表示委婉客气的现在语气，主句不是过去时，不可机械把从句误变成过去时！

exercises.question: Excuse me, could you tell me ______?
options: A. where does the bus stop
B. where the bus stops
C. when will the train arrive
D. what is your sister doing
exercises.explanation: 宾语从句必须使用陈述语序（主语在前，谓语在后）。A项 does 提前倒装错误；C项 will 提前错误；D项 is 提前错误。只有 B 项 where the bus stops 为标准陈述语序。故选 B。

exercises.question: The little girl asked her science teacher ______.
options: A. why the moon looks round and bright
B. whether does it rain tomorrow
C. what was the sun made of
D. why did the leaves turn yellow in autumn
exercises.explanation: A项为陈述语序，且询问自然客观规律用一般现在时，正确；B项 does 倒装错误；C项太阳构成属于客观事实不应降为过去时 was；D项 did 倒装错误。故选 A。

chap_04_p01.name: 基数词的构成规律与大数时刻表达
chap_04_p01.page_ref: 手绘语法教材 P24-P27 · 对应外研七上 Starter

citations.source: 外研七上 Starter 真实对白
citations.text: Li Ming: What time is it now? Mum: It is twenty past seven. We have twenty-five minutes before the school bus arrives.
citations.note: twenty past seven 为逆读法（分 + past + 点钟）；twenty-five 几十几之间需加连字符。

citations.source: 初中英语语法图解 (P25) 大数规则
citations.text: hundred, thousand, million 前面有具体数词时，用单数且不加 of (two thousand students)；表示不确定的概数时用复数且加 of (thousands of students)。
citations.note: 公式口诀：前有具体数，单位不加 s；后有 of 连，单位加 s 表成千上万。

rules: 时间顺读法：点钟 + 分钟 (7:20 -> seven twenty)。
时间逆读法：分钟 <= 30 用 past (7:20 -> twenty past seven; 7:30 -> half past seven)；分钟 > 30 用 to (7:40 -> twenty to eight)。一刻钟用 a quarter (7:15 -> a quarter past seven)。
大数字三位分节法：从右往左每三位加逗号，第一个逗号读 thousand，第二个读 million，第三个读 billion。百位与十位之间用 and (two hundred and thirty)。
chap_04_p01.pitfalls: 【必考混淆点】：two hundred (确数，不能加 s) vs hundreds of (概数，必须加 s 和 of)；基数词连字符复合形容词单数名词 (an 8-year-old girl，中考单选必考，year 不能加 s)。

exercises.question: Every year, ______ tourists from all over the world come to visit the Great Wall.
options: A. thousand of
B. thousands of
C. five thousands
D. five thousand of
exercises.explanation: 表示成千上万的概数概念，数词单位需加 -s 并与 of 连用：thousands of；若有具体数字 five，则需用 five thousand。故选 B。

exercises.question: The boy who won the reading competition is an ______ student.
options: A. 13-year-old
B. 13-years-old
C. 13 years old
D. 13 year old
exercises.explanation: 由“数词-名词-形容词”构成的复合形容词，名词必须用单数形式 (year) 且单词之间用连字符连接，在句中作定语修饰 student。故选 A。

chap_04_p02.name: 序数词的构成口诀与特殊用法
chap_04_p02.page_ref: 手绘语法教材 P28-P31 · 对应外研七上短语专项

citations.source: 外研七上词汇资料原句
citations.text: The science laboratory is on the second floor of Building A. Today is October the first.
citations.note: 楼层与日期必须使用序数词 (second, first)，且前面通常加定冠词 the。

citations.source: 初中英语序数词速记手绘金牌口诀 (P28)
citations.text: 一二三特殊记 (first, second, third)；th 从四起；八去 t (eighth) 九去 e (ninth)；ve 要用 f 替 (fifth, twelfth)；ty 变 tie (twentieth, fortieth)；若是遇到几十几，只变个位就可以 (twenty-first)。
citations.note: 缩写形式：1st, 2nd, 3rd, 4th, 21st, 22nd。

rules: 构成规则：牢记“基变序”口诀，尤其注意 ninth (去e), eighth (去t), fifth/twelfth (ve变f), fortieth (y变ie)。
定冠词 the + 序数词：表示特定的次序 (the second time, the third question)。
不定冠词 a/an + 序数词：表示“又一，再一” (He tried a third time, but failed again)。
chap_04_p02.pitfalls: 【易混点】：ninth 千万不要写成 *nineth*；fortieth 千万不要写成 *fourtieth*；a second time（再来一次，不表特定排位）。

exercises.question: December is the ______ month of a year, and Christmas is on the ______ of this month.
options: A. twelve; twenty-five
B. twelfth; twenty-fifth
C. twelveth; twenty-fifth
D. twelfth; twenty-five
exercises.explanation: 第十二个月为 twelfth (ve变f加th，不带e)；第二十五天为 twenty-fifth (只变个位)。故选 B。

exercises.question: Although he failed twice, he decided to have ______ third try.
options: A. a
B. the
C. an
exercises.explanation: a + 序数词表示“又一，再一”，强调追加的尝试，而非指代原本预设的特定排位。故选 A。

chap_06_p01.name: 情态动词 can / must / may / should 基本用法与推测语气
chap_06_p01.chapter: 第6章 动词：情态与非谓语
chap_06_p01.page_ref: 手绘语法教材 P58-P63 · 对应中考单选必考

citations.source: 外研七上交际情景原句
citations.text: Students must keep quiet in the reading room. You can borrow three books at a time, but you mustn't take them away without asking.
citations.note: must 表必须；can 表许可与能力；mustn't 强烈表示严禁、禁止。

citations.source: 初中英语推测语气手绘对照表 (P61)
citations.text: 肯定推测用 must (一定/肯定)；可能推测用 may/might (也许/可能)；否定推测用 can't (绝不可能)。
citations.note: 注意：表示否定推测时绝不能用 mustn't，mustn't 意思是‘禁止’！

rules: 情态动词后必须紧跟动词原形，没有人称和数的变化 (He must do it)。
否定回答特殊点：—Must I finish it now? —No, you needn't. / No, you don't have to. (不必，绝不能用 mustn't 回答！)
推测语气等级：must be (100% 肯定) > may/might be (50% 也许) > can't be (0% 绝不可能)。
chap_06_p01.pitfalls: 【中考最高频陷阱】：—Must I hand in my homework today? —No, you needn't.（否定回答只能用 needn't，用 mustn't 直接判错）。

exercises.question:
—Must we clean the classroom right now?
—No, you ______. You can do it after the last class.
options: A. mustn't
B. can't
C. needn't
D. shouldn't
exercises.explanation: 以 Must 提问的一般疑问句，否定回答表示“不必”，必须用 No, you needn't 或 you don't have to。mustn't 意为“禁止”，不符合语境。故选 C。

exercises.question:
—Is the man standing under the tree Mr. Wang?
—It ______ be him. He has gone to London for an international conference.
options: A. mustn't
B. can't
C. may
D. needn't
exercises.explanation: 后句说明王老师已经去伦敦开会了，因此在树下的人“绝不可能是他”，表确定否定推测必须使用 can't。故选 B。

chap_06_p03.name: 非谓语动词：动词不定式 to do 与动名词 doing
chap_06_p03.chapter: 第6章 动词：情态与非谓语
chap_06_p03.page_ref: 手绘语法教材 P66-P71 · 对应中考语法填空必考

citations.source: 外研七上课文原句
citations.text: Emma decided to start a writing club because she enjoys sharing fantasy stories with others.
citations.note: decide to do sth (决定做某事接不定式)；enjoy doing sth (喜欢做某事接动名词)。

citations.source: 初中英语速记口诀 (P68)
citations.text: enjoy, finish, practice 后接 doing；decide, want, hope, agree 后接 to do；stop to do (停下去做另一件事) vs stop doing (停止正在做的事)。
citations.note: remember/forget to do (未做) vs doing (已做)；介词后面一律接 doing！

rules: 只接 doing 的常见动词：enjoy, finish, practice, mind, consider, keep, suggest, feel like, look forward to (to 为介词)。
只接 to do 的常见动词：want, hope, wish, decide, refuse, agree, promise, expect, choose, plan。
感官使役动词省 to：see, hear, notice, watch, make, let, have 后面接省略 to 的不定式 (make sb do sth)；但变为被动语态时必须把 to 还原！(He was made to work hard)。
chap_06_p03.pitfalls: 【易混陷阱】：look forward to hearing from you (to 是介词，必须接 hearing，不能接 hear)；forget to close the door (门还没关) vs forget closing the door (关过门但忘了)。

exercises.question: I am really looking forward to ______ my pen pal from Australia this summer holiday.
options: A. visit
B. visiting
C. visited
D. to visit
exercises.explanation: look forward to 中 to 是介词，介词后面必须接动名词 doing (visiting)。故选 B。

exercises.question: The boy was tired, so he stopped ______ a rest under the big tree.
options: A. having
B. to have
C. have
D. had
exercises.explanation: stop to do sth 表示停下手中的事情去开始做另一件事（去休息）；stop doing 表示停止当前正在做的事。由语境可知男孩停下来去休息，故选 B。

chap_07_p01.name: 形容词与副词的比较级、最高级及核心句型
chap_07_p01.chapter: 第7章 形容词与副词
chap_07_p01.page_ref: 手绘语法教材 P72-P79 · 对应中考高频考点

citations.source: 中考真题与课文精选原句
citations.text: The more books you read, the wiser you will become. English is one of the most widely used languages in the world.
citations.note: the + 比较级..., the + 比较级... 表越……越……；one of the + 最高级 + 复数名词表最……之一。

citations.source: 初中英语手绘变化口诀 (P74)
citations.text: 单音节直接加 er/est；大胖子重读闭音节双写末尾字母 (big->bigger, hot->hotter)；辅音+y 变 i 加 er/est (easy->easier)；多音节前面加 more/most。
citations.note: 不规则变化表：good/well -> better -> best; bad/badly -> worse -> worst; many/much -> more -> most; little -> less -> least; far -> farther/further -> farthest/furthest。

rules: 两者比较用比较级：A + be + 比较级 + than + B；修饰比较级的程度副词：much, a lot, even, far, a little (绝对不能用 very 修饰比较级)。
三者及以上用最高级：the + 最高级 + of/in 范围；one of the + 最高级 + 复数名词 (one of the tallest buildings)。
同级比较句型：as + 形容词/副词原级 + as (和……一样)；not as/so + 原级 + as (不如……)。
chap_07_p01.pitfalls: 【经典陷阱】：the more..., the more... 结构后必须用比较级；much 才能修饰比较级 (much better)，绝不能说 *very better*！

exercises.question: With the development of technology, electric cars are becoming ______ than before.
options: A. popular
B. more popular
C. most popular
D. the most popular
exercises.explanation: 句中有两者对比标志词 than，且 popular 是多音节词，其比较级前需加 more。故选 B。

exercises.question: The ______ you practice speaking English, the ______ mistakes you will make.
options: A. more; less
B. much; few
C. more; fewer
D. most; fewest
exercises.explanation: 固定句式“the + 比较级，the + 比较级”表示“越……就越……”。mistakes 是可数名词复数，修饰可数名词复数的少用 fewer（few的比较级），less 只能修饰不可数名词。故选 C。

chap_09_p01.name: 主谓一致三大原则与 There be 句型就近原则
chap_09_p01.chapter: 第9章 简单句与主谓一致
chap_09_p01.page_ref: 手绘语法教材 P100-P107 · 对应中考必考

citations.source: 外研七上课文与笔记原题
citations.text: There is a pencil case and three notebooks on the desk. Neither Tom nor his parents like watching TV.
citations.note: There be 句型与 neither...nor 遵从“就近原则”，谓语动词随距离最近的主语单复数变化。

citations.source: 初中英语语法图解 (P102)
citations.text: 语法一致：单数主语单数谓语；意义一致：集体名词 (family, class) 强调整体用单，强调成员用复；就近原则：there be, either...or, neither...nor, not only...but also。
citations.note: 就远原则：主语 + as well as / with / together with，谓语动词与前面的第一主语保持一致！

rules: 就近原则：There be, either A or B, neither A nor B, not only A but also B，谓语动词形式取决于靠近动词的那个名词/代词。
就远原则：主语 + with / together with / along with / as well as / including，谓语动词由最前面的主语决定 (The teacher, with her students, is reading books)。
数量短语主谓一致：a number of + 复数名词 (谓语用复数，意为许多)；the number of + 复数名词 (谓语用单数，意为……的数量)。
chap_09_p01.pitfalls: 【易错考点】：The teacher with two students ______ (is/are)? with 结构属于就远原则，第一主语 The teacher 是单数，必须用 is！

exercises.question: There ______ a ruler and two erasers in the pencil case.
options: A. is
B. are
C. be
D. were
exercises.explanation: There be 句型遵从“就近原则”，紧邻 be 动词的名词是单数 a ruler，因此 be 动词选用单数形式 is。故选 A。

exercises.question: Mr. Smith, along with his two sons, ______ basketball on the playground every Saturday.
options: A. play
B. plays
C. are playing
D. were playing
exercises.explanation: along with 结构遵从“就远原则”，主语核心词是 Mr. Smith（第三人称单数），日常习惯动作使用一般现在时，动词需加 -s 变为 plays。故选 B。

chap_10_p02.name: 状语从句体系与“主将从现”核心铁律
chap_10_p02.page_ref: 手绘语法教材 P116-P121 · 对应中考必考考点

citations.source: 中考真题阅读与课文经典原句
citations.text: If it doesn't rain tomorrow, we will go for an autumn picnic in the forest park.
citations.note: if 引导条件状语从句，主句为一般将来时 (will go)，从句使用一般现在时 (doesn't rain) 表将来。

citations.source: 初中英语速记口诀 (P118)
citations.text: 主将从现四大从句：时间状从 (when, as soon as, until), 条件状从 (if, unless)。主句一般将来时，从句一般现在时代替将来时！
citations.note: 主句若为祈使句或含有情态动词 (can/must)，从句同样使用一般现在时。

rules: 主将从现原则：主句用一般将来时 / 祈使句 / 情态动词，时间或条件状语从句中用一般现在时表将来。
连词辨析：unless = if not (除非，如果不)；as soon as (一……就……)；not...until (直到……才)；although / though (尽管，绝不能与 but 连用)；so...that (如此……以至于)。
chap_10_p02.pitfalls: 【经典陷阱】：Although he was ill, ______ he still went to work.（错选 but！although 与 but 绝不能出现在同一个复合句中）。

exercises.question: We will have a sports meeting next Friday if it ______ fine.
options: A. will be
B. is
C. was
D. are
exercises.explanation: if 引导条件状语从句，符合“主将从现”原则，主句是一般将来时 will have，从句主语 it 是单数，必须使用一般现在时 is。故选 B。

exercises.question: You won't catch the early train ______ you get up right away.
options: A. if
B. because
C. unless
D. although
exercises.explanation: unless 引导条件状语从句，意为“除非，如果不”，相当于 if...not。句意为：除非你马上起床，否则赶不上早班火车。故选 C。

chap_10_p03.name: 定语从句入门：先行词定位与关系代词选用
chap_10_p03.page_ref: 手绘语法教材 P122-P127 · 对应中考压轴阅读与完形

citations.source: 课文与经典长难句引用
citations.text: The scientist who won the Nobel Prize spent over thirty years conducting experiments in his laboratory.
citations.note: 先行词为 The scientist（指人），关系代词 who 在定语从句中作主语。

citations.source: 初中英语手绘关系词选用树 (P123)
citations.text: 先行词是指人，主格用 who，宾格用 whom；先行词是指物，用 which 或 that；先行词是定语（谁的），一律用 whose。
citations.note: 只能用 that 的特殊场景：先行词被最高级/序数词修饰；先行词是不定代词 (all, anything, nothing)；先行词既有人又有物。

rules: 先行词定位：被定语从句修饰的名词或代词叫先行词，通常紧贴定语从句前。
关系代词双重身份：既起连接主从句作用，又在从句中充当主语、宾语或定语。
必用 that 的六大高频场景：1. 先行词为 all, everything, nothing, little 等不定代词；2. 先行词被序数词或最高级修饰；3. 先行词被 the only, the very 修饰；4. 先行词既有人又有物；5. 疑问词开头的避免重复。
chap_10_p03.pitfalls: 【易混点】：The book ______ I bought yesterday is interesting. 先行词是书（物），在从句中作宾语，可填 which/that 或省略；但先行词被 the first 修饰时只能用 that。

exercises.question: This is the most touching movie ______ I have ever watched in my life.
options: A. which
B. that
C. who
D. what
exercises.explanation: 先行词 movie 被形容词最高级 the most touching 修饰，定语从句关系代词必须使用 that，不可使用 which。故选 B。

exercises.question: I like teachers ______ are patient and always encourage students to think actively.
options: A. whom
B. who
C. which
D. whose
exercises.explanation: 先行词 teachers 指人，且关系代词在从句中充当主语（紧接 are patient），应选用主格关系代词 who。whom 只能在从句中充当宾语。故选 B。

chap_02_p07.name: 不定冠词 a / an 的读音判别与泛指用法
chap_02_p07.page_ref: 手绘教材 P10 · 对应中考考点

citations.source: 外研版初中英语与课文原句引用
citations.text: Tina's mother is an actress. She plays the erhu and likes playing basketball.
citations.note: 在真实语篇中考查【不定冠词 a / an 的读音判别与泛指用法】的典型用法与语境感知。

mat_01.title: 01. 学生日常活动安排与开学准备

mat_01.textbook: 外研版（WY）七年级上册 Starter
mat_01.overview: 收录李明与妈妈关于初一第一天入学的经典真实对话，涉及书包物品清点、日常作息日程安排（Get ready）及生活交际。

citations.speaker: Mum & Li Ming
citations.content:
— Mum: Tomorrow is your first day of junior high school. Are you ready?
— Li Ming: Yes, Mum!
— Mum: Where is your schoolbag?
— Li Ming: It's on the chair. I have put my notebooks, pens and pencil case in it.

citations.speaker: Dr Chang (Developing Ideas)
citations.content: — We all know 'problem children'. But do you know 'problem parents'? Children sometimes call me to talk about their problem parents. For example, Tina's mother is an actress...

grammar_focus: 一般现在时态与日常日程：Our class begins at 8:00 a.m.
名词单复数识别：three pens, two notebooks
方位介词搭配：on the chair, in the bag

exercises.question:
—Is your schoolbag ready for tomorrow, Li Ming?
—Yes, I have put my ______ and ______ in it.
options: A. pencil box; rulers
B. pencil boxes; rulers
C. pencils boxes; ruler
D. pencil box; ruler
exercises.explanation: pencil box 复合名词复数形式在核心名词后加 -es (pencil boxes)；rulers 为规则名词复数。故选 B。

exercises.question: School ______ at 8:00 a.m. every weekday, so I must get up early.
options: A. start
B. starts
C. started
D. starting
exercises.explanation: School 在此作为单数主语，日常作息表使用一般现在时，谓语动词需用第三人称单数 starts。故选 B。

mat_02.title: 02. 温馨家庭瞬间分享与生活点滴
mat_02.tag: Family ties 亲情精读与表达
mat_02.source_file: 试卷去手写_温馨家庭瞬间分享.pdf (30页)
mat_02.textbook: 外研版（WY）七年级上册 Unit 3
mat_02.overview: 精读单元以‘家庭瞬间（Family Moments）’为主题，通过照片描述亲人间的关爱与温暖，并对中国传统谚语‘家和万事兴’进行了深度文化双语阐释。

citations.speaker: Reading Passage
citations.content: Draw and write about a loving family moment. Then share it with the class. Use the words and expressions from the reading passage to help you. A picture of a loving family moment brings tears of joy to my eyes.

citations.speaker: Did You Know? (谚语引用)
citations.content: "A happy family brings success in everything." It's a famous Chinese saying. Who understands this better than those who have experienced true warmth at home?

grammar_focus: 物主代词与描写：my family, his smiling face, our happy memories
动词第三人称单数：brings success in everything
感叹与感悟表达句型：How warm and loving they are!

exercises.question: "A happy family ______ success in everything" is a well-known proverb that teaches us the importance of harmony at home.
options: A. bring
B. brings
C. bringing
D. brought
exercises.explanation: 名言警句与客观规律一律使用一般现在时，主语 A happy family 为单数概念，动词需用三单形式 brings。故选 B。

exercises.question: Looking at the old photo, the girl remembered the sweet memories with ______ grandparents.
options: A. she
B. her
C. hers
D. herself
exercises.explanation: 修饰后面的名词 grandparents，需要使用形容词性物主代词 her。故选 B。

mat_03.title: 03. 启帆课学习笔记之句型转换与语法
mat_03.tag: 同步语法辅导与句型转换
mat_03.source_file: 试卷去手写_启帆课学习笔记编著信息.pdf (30页)
mat_03.textbook: 沈阳出版发行集团 · 外研版七上同步辅导
mat_03.overview: 系统梳理外研七上重难点：名词单复数、冠词泛指与特指、数词时刻与顺序、一般现在时（含肯定/否定/一般疑问句转换公式与易错点）。

citations.speaker: 启帆课笔记精要
citations.content: A new start: Nouns; numbers; articles; simple present tense; future tense. Learning to think: Understanding a famous saying; Rock music meets the erhu.

citations.speaker: 句型转换公式
citations.content: 肯定句变否定句：有 be 动词后加 not，无 be 动词借助动词 don't / doesn't（三单动词变回原形）；变一般疑问句助动词提前，第一人称变第二人称。

grammar_focus: 五大基本时态变形：do/does, will do, be going to do
句型转换逻辑（主谓一致与助动词协同）
疑问词辨析：What, Who, Where, When, Why, How

exercises.question:
句型转换：Tom studies English hard every day.（改为否定句）
Tom ______ English hard every day.
options: A. doesn't studies
B. don't study
C. doesn't study
D. isn't study
exercises.explanation: 主语 Tom 为第三人称单数，实义动词 studies 变否定需借助助动词 doesn't，且后面的实义动词必须还原为原形 study。故选 C。

exercises.question:
句型转换：There are thirty students in our class.（对划线部分 thirty 提问）
______ students are there in your class?
options: A. How much
B. How many
C. How long
D. How far
exercises.explanation: students 为可数名词复数，对数量提问必须使用 How many。How much 用于修饰不可数名词。故选 B。

mat_04.title: 04. 埃玛图书馆交友记与校园日常精读
mat_04.tag: 校园短篇小说与电影双语精读
mat_04.source_file: 试卷去手写_埃玛图书馆交友记.pdf (24页)
mat_04.textbook: 外研版（WY）七年级上册 Unit 4
mat_04.overview: 包含转学生 Emma 在图书馆打破孤独、主动组建写作俱乐部与结交朋友的生动故事；同时节选了经典电影《那山那人那狗》山间父子同行的感人双语篇目。

citations.speaker: Emma in the Library
citations.content: Emma lifted her head and stopped writing. She had just moved to this new school without any old classmates. She felt a little lonely... 'Why not start a writing club here after lunch on Wednesday?' she thought.

citations.speaker: Understanding Ideas (《那山那人那狗》精选)
citations.content: Along the mountain path, a handsome young man walks quickly. A serious-looking old man follows behind him. This comes from my favorite movie Postmen in the Mountains. It is a touching story about the deep love between a father and a son.

grammar_focus: 并列连词与对比：while / and / but
提建议句型：Why not do sth? / Let's do sth.

exercises.question:
—I feel a little bored this weekend.
—______ join our school reading club? We read fantastic books every Saturday.
options: A. Why don't
B. Why not
C. What about
D. How about
exercises.explanation: 后接动词原形 join，Why not do sth?（为什么不……呢？）是标准提建议句型；What about / How about 后需接动名词 doing。故选 B。

exercises.question: Along the country road, the boy walks happily, ______ his father watches him with a warm smile.
options: A. while
B. or
C. so
D. because
exercises.explanation: while 在此处作并列连词，表示“而，与此同时”，连接两个动作的对比与呼应。故选 A。

mat_05.title: 05. 汉译英词汇列表（第三遍乱序默写表）
mat_05.tag: 全册核心词汇与词性自测
mat_05.source_file: 试卷去手写_汉译英词汇列表（第三遍乱序）.pdf (30页)
mat_05.textbook: 外研版（WY）七年级上册 单词专项
mat_05.overview: 精选全册 300+ 核心考查词汇，打破字母与单元顺序进行乱序排列，强制大脑调用语义关联记忆，并标注动词、名词、形容词、代词属性及不规则变化。

citations.speaker: 乱序词表节选 (Starter - Unit 2)
citations.content:
1. 校服 -> school uniform (n.)
2. 你自己 -> yourself / yourselves (pron.)
3. 历史 -> history (n.)
4. 参加, 参与 -> take part in (v.)
5. 任务, 工作 -> task / job (n.)
6. 确实地, 的确 -> truly / indeed (adv.)

grammar_focus: 词性转换考点：history -> historical, different -> difference
动词词组搭配：take part in, look forward to

exercises.question: Many students are proud of wearing their clean ______ at the school opening ceremony.
options: A. uniforms
B. uniform
C. dresses
D. clothes
exercises.explanation: uniform 作校服/制服讲为可数名词，主语 Many students 对应复数形式 uniforms。故选 A。

exercises.question: It's an honor for our school team to ______ the city sports meet.
options: A. take place
B. take part in
C. take care of
D. take off
exercises.explanation: take part in 意为“参加、参与”大型群众性活动、运动会或比赛。take place 为发生；take care of 为照料；take off 为起飞/脱下。故选 B。

mat_06.title: 06. 汉语词汇学习资料与日常对话搭配
mat_06.tag: 功能意念短语与社交交际
mat_06.source_file: 试卷去手写_汉语词汇学习资料.pdf (30页)
mat_06.textbook: 外研版（WY）七年级上册 表达专项
mat_06.overview: 系统梳理初一日常交流高频短语：欢迎来到某地、学习新事物、楼层方位表达（美式 vs 英式）、运动邀请与日常礼貌回应等功能意念项目。

citations.speaker: 核心短语配对清单
citations.content:
1. 欢迎来到... -> welcome to...
2. 学习新事物 -> learn new things
3. 在一楼/二楼/三楼 -> on the first/second/third floor (美式: 1st floor即首层; 英式: ground floor为首层, 1st floor为二楼)
4. 结交新朋友 -> make new friends
5. 彼此, 互相 -> each other / one another

grammar_focus: 介词与楼层/地点搭配：on the floor, at school
动宾固定搭配：make friends, have fun
英美文化差异表达：first floor 楼层概念辨析

exercises.question: Our art club is located ______ the second floor of the new teaching building.
options: A. in
B. on
C. at
D. to
exercises.explanation: 在几楼表面固定使用介词 on (on the first/second/third floor)。故选 B。

exercises.question: The teacher encouraged all the new students to ______ with each other.
options: A. make friends
B. make a friend
C. take friends
D. keep friend
exercises.explanation: make friends with sb 意为“与某人交朋友”，friends 习惯使用复数形式。故选 A。
